title: Chapter 441 The Last Moment
content:
Chapter 441 The Last Moment

Click—

Lu Xuexiu's hand veins bulged, and the Tianji Mirror in her hand squeezed out several cracks because she tried too hard.

"Ao—Qing—!!!"

Through the Tianji Mirror, Lu Xue's angry voice suddenly traveled through countless spaces and directly entered the hall where Ao Qing was.

Just as Ao Qing was slowly enjoying this rare happy time, an angry voice suddenly came.

"ah!!"

In the hall, several little dragon girls were immediately scared and their faces changed, and the music around them also came to an abrupt end.

At this time, Ao Qing woke up a little bit in a daze and looked around.

"Huh? What happened?"

Ao Qing burped, but her face was still filled with drunkenness.

The little dragon girl beside her immediately responded, "Mr. Ao Qing, it seems like there is a cry calling you just now."

"Yeah, but I don't know who it is?"

Upon hearing this, Ao Qing was a little confused, "Call? Why didn't I hear it? You guys are drunk too much, right?"

Looking at Ao Qing's appearance, several little dragon girls looked at each other and were all silent.

"Don't think too much, enjoy it."

"There are not many such wonderful times."

Then, Ao Qing raised his palm and ordered to the side, "Switch on the music and dance."

Suddenly, the cheerful music echoed from the hall again.

On the other side, he looked at Ao Qing's indifferent look.

Lu Xue, who had been backfired by the Tianji Mirror, could no longer hold on with some internal injuries.

Puff ~

A mouthful of blood spurted out, and Lu Xue fainted.

"Miss Lu Xue, what's wrong with you, Miss Lu Xue?!"

"Ah! Come on, come on!!"

Also in the deserted city, the competition for the list at this time has undoubtedly reached its climax.

On the list of geniuses.

Gong Ting half-squatted on the ground, gasping for breath, his eyes with a little disbelief.

"How could this happen, Xingcai, you,"

"Gong Ting, you are not my opponent."

Although Xu Xingcai in the distance also suffered some injuries, it was much better than Gong Ting.

It is already known at this moment that it is stronger and weaker.

"Ha, hehe, I didn't expect that I was so unbearable."

Gong Ting, who suffered consecutive blows, was already a little crazy at this moment.

He lost to Lingji of the Holy Spirit clan, which made him feel very uncomfortable, but now, he is going to lose to Xu Xingcai again, to this sister who has given up since he was a child.

So, he should not give in to Xu Xingcai at all, as he is very strong himself.

So what have I been doing over the years?

With a plop, Gong Ting sat down on the ground with no more fighting spirit. He looked at Xu Xingcai in the distance with numb eyes, laughed sarcastically, and asked, "Xingcai, for so many years, In your eyes, isn’t it always a joke?”

Xu Xingcai's face was calm, she looked at Gong Ting for a long time, and said softly, "I have always treated you as my brother."

Gong Ting was slightly stunned, and immediately lowered his head, not daring to see Xu Xingcai.

"I lost."

Gong Ting suddenly spurted out blood from his mouth, choosing to break himself.

When he was dying, Xu Xingcai heard the last sentence from Gong Ting, "Little heart and hair."

Outside the Tianjiao List.

"What's the situation?! Gong Ting lost to Xu Xingcai?"

Looking at the second place in the Tianjiao List, someone dared not believe it.

"I've heard that the relationship between Ting and Xu Xingcai in the Human Emperor Palace has a different relationship. It seems that it's true."

Hearing someone say this, the strong man from the Human Emperor Palace at the scene was also a little dissatisfied, "What is this Gong Ting doing? He is still showing mercy at this time."

"Oh, he is hurting that girl."

As soon as he finished speaking, Gong Ting's figure appeared in the square.

Seeing Gong Ting, the strong man from the Human Emperor Palace hurried forward.

"Gong Ting, how can you do this? Do you think that if you deliberately lose to Xingcai, she will win Lingji?"

"Yes, Gong Ting, what you did this time is a big mistake. Even you are not Lingji's opponent, so how can Xingcai?"

Listening to the reproaches and questioning in his ears, Gong Ting took a deep breath and said slowly, "I didn't hold back. Xingcai is better than me."

"Um?"

"You, what did you say?"

Gong Ting raised his head, looked at these seniors who had taken special care of him since childhood, and said straight: "I said, Xingcai is better than me."

On the other side of the square, Bai Xu has already entered the Tianjiao List.

More and more geniuses appear in an attempt to challenge Bai Xu.

Bai Xu simply entered the special cultivation space on the Tianjiao List.

Bai Ling had not challenged her yet, but looked at the Tianjiao List and asked, "Qinghai, will that Xu Xingcai be Lingqi's opponent?"

Beside him, Qinghai slowly opened his eyes and raised a somewhat conceited smile on his lips, "Is it meaningful? It's just a fight for second place."

Bai Ling: "..."

No, are you all so strong?

A few more hours passed.

The top position of the Tianjiao List became Xu Xingcai.

The entire Huangcheng Square suddenly fell into a brief silence.

After a brief moment of dazing, the strong human race suddenly cheered.

Even though it was a bit unexpected, there was no doubt that Xu Xingcai had saved their human race.

Since then, the name Xu Xingcai has finally begun to shine throughout the Chaos Realm.

"Qinghai, Xu Xingcai won, Qing, huh?"

Before Bai Ling could finish his words, he suddenly found that Qinghai beside him had disappeared from the spot at some point.

Looking up at the Tianjiao List again, Qinghai's name had already appeared in it.

.........

On the other side, on the combat power list.

Although the Tianjiao List and the combat power list are in this Huangcheng Square, since the Huangcheng Square is very huge, it will take some time to go from one end of the square to the other.

Fortunately, the rules contained in the two lists make everyone look up and see the information they want to see, no matter where they are on the square.

"Damn, I can't even get the top spot at this time."

Outside the combat power list, Mo Chou, who had just finished, looked at his ranking with some depression.

third.

He is the Supreme Holy Grade Heaven, and even among the Supreme Holy Grade Heaven, he is a first-class master.

But now, he is only ranked third.

The Haohan Ancestor, who once dominated the list for a short period of time, had already been out of the thirty places at this time.

The emergence of the combat power list has caused those strong men who have been famous to be on the list one after another. Some Lao Liu, who has not shown his strength and has always been hiding his strength, also appeared in the world and came to the list.

With such huge competitiveness, a small gap in strength can lead to several places.

At this time, there was only one day left before the first settlement of the combat power list ended.

The strong people coming towards this place are still increasing, and their strength is still very strong.

At this moment, a very spiritual breath appeared and then floated across the square.

Everyone breathed and then looked there.

A woman emitting holy light was slowly walking towards this place.

The leader of the Holy Spirit Clan, currently the strongest person in the Holy Spirit Clan.
